height: 100%; }\n  .attr-human-fill { background: var(--green); height: 100%; }\n\n  /* Summary box */\n  .summary-box { background: rgba(88,166,255,.04); border: 1px solid rgba(88,166,255,.1); border-radius: 6px; padding: 10px 12px; }\n  .summary-box .intent { font-size: 13px; color: var(--text); margin-bottom: 4px; }\n  .summary-box .outcome { font-size: 12px; color: var(--text-muted); }\n\n  /* Code / blob viewer */\n  .blob-viewer { background: var(--bg-code); border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 6px; max-height: 500px; overflow: auto; margin-top: 8px; }\n  .blob-content { font-family: var(--font-mono); font-size: 11px; line-height: 1.6; color: var(--text-muted); padding: 12px; white-space: pre-wrap; word-break: break-all; }\n  .blob-loading { padding: 20px; color: var(--text-dim); font-size: 12px; text-align: center; }\n\n  /* File browser */\n  .file-browser { border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 6px; overflow: hidden; }\n  .file-entry { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; padding: 6px 12px; font-family: var(--font-mono); font-size: 11px; color: var(--text-muted); border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(48,54,61,.3); cursor: pointer; transition: background .1s; }\n  .file-entry:last-child { border-bottom: none; }\n  .file-entry:hover { background: var(--bg-card-hover); color: var(--text); }\n  .file-entry.active { background: rgba(88,166,255,.08); color: var(--accent); }\n  .file-icon { font-size: 12px; width: 16px; text-align: center; flex-shrink: 0; }\n\n  /* Learnings list */\n  .learning-item { font-size: 12px; color: var(--text-muted); padding: 4px 0; border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(48,54,61,.3); }\n  .learning-item:last-child { border-bottom: none; }\n  .learning-path { font-family: var(--font-mono); font-size: 11px; color: var(--accent); }\n  .learning-finding { margin-top: 2px; }\n\n  /* Timeline dots */\n  .timeline { position: relative; padding-left: 24px; }\n  .timeline::before { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 7px; top: 0; bottom: 0; width: 2px; background: var(--border); }\n  .timeline .card::before { content: ''; position: absolute; left: -21px; top: 16px; width: 10px; height: 10px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--accent-dim); border: 2px solid var(--accent); }\n  .timeline .card { position: relative; }\n\n  /* Sub-session cards in checkpoint detail */\n  .sub-session { background: var(--bg-card); border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 6px; margin-bottom: 8px; }\n  .sub-session-header { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 8px 12px; cursor: pointer; font-size: 12px; }\n  .sub-session-detail { display: none; border-top: 1px solid var(--border); padding: 12px; }\n  .sub-session.expanded .sub-session-detail { display: block; }\n  .sub-session .chevron { font-size: 10px; }\n  .sub-session.expanded .chevron { transform: rotate(90deg); }\n\n  /* Raw JSON toggle */\n  .raw-toggle { font-size: 11px; color: var(--text-dim); cursor: pointer; padding: 2px 8px; border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 4px; background: var(--bg); transition: color .15s, border-color .15s; user-select: none; }\n  .raw-toggle:hover { color: var(--text-muted); border-color: var(--text-dim); }\n  .raw-toggle.active { color: var(--accent); border-color: var(--accent-dim); }\n\n  /* Empty state */\n  .empty-state { text-align: center; padding: 48px 20px; color: var(--text-dim); font-size: 14px; }\n  .empty-icon { font-size: 28px; margin-bottom: 8px; opacity: .4; }\n\n  .error-banner { background: rgba(248,81,73,.1); border: 1px solid rgba(248,81,73,.3); color: var(--red); padding: 8px 16px; border-radius: var(--radius); font-size: 13px; margin-bottom: 12px; display: none; }\n\n  /* Prompt attributions */\n  .prompt-attr-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: auto 1fr 1fr 1fr 1fr; gap: 0; font-size: 11px; font-family: var(--font-mono); }\n  .prompt-attr-grid .cell { padding: 3px 8px; border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(48,54,61,.3); }\n  .prompt-attr-grid .cell-header { font-weight: 600; color: var(--text-dim); text-transform: uppercase; font-size: 10px; letter-spacing: .03em; }\n</style>\n</head>\n<body>\n<header>\n  <div class=\"header-top\">\n    <h1>Checkpoint Viewer</h1>\n    <span class=\"branch-badge\" id=\"branch\">...</span>\n    <div class=\"refresh-indicator\"><span class=\"refresh-dot\"></span><span>auto-refresh 3s</span></div>\n  </div>\n  <nav class=\"tabs\">\n    <div class=\"tab active\" data-tab=\"sessions\">Tracked Sessions <span class=\"tab-count\" id=\"tc-sessions\">0</span></div>\n    <div class=\"tab\" data-tab=\"checkpoints\">Checkpoints <span class=\"tab-count\" id=\"tc-checkpoints\">0</span></div>\n    <div class=\"tab\" data-tab=\"shadow\">Shadow Branches <span class=\"tab-count\" id=\"tc-shadow\">0</span></div>\n  </nav>\n</header>\n\n<main>\n  <div class=\"error-banner\" id=\"error-banner\"></div>\n  <div id=\"panel-sessions\" class=\"tab-panel active\"></div>\n  <div id=\"panel-checkpoints\" class=\"tab-panel\"></div>\n  <div id=\"panel-shadow\" class=\"tab-panel\"></div>\n</main>\n\n<script>\n/* ---- Helpers ---- */\nconst rtf = new Intl.RelativeTimeFormat('en', { numeric: 'auto' });\nfunction relTime(d) {\n  if (!d) return '';\n  const ms = new Date(d).getTime() - Date.now();\n  const s = Math.round(ms/1000), m = Math.round(ms/60000), h = Math.round(ms/3600000), dy = Math.round(ms/86400000);\n  if (Math.abs(s)<60) return rtf.format(s,'second');\n  if (Math.abs(m)<60) return rtf.format(m,'minute');\n  if (Math.abs(h)<24) return rtf.format(h,'hour');\n  return rtf.format(dy,'day');\n}\nfunction esc(s) { return s == null ? '' : String(s).replace(/&/g,'&amp;').replace(/</g,'&lt;').replace(/>/g,'&gt;').replace(/\"/g,'&quot;'); }\nfunction fmtNum(n) { if(n==null)return'0'; if(n>=1e6)return(n/1e6).toFixed(1)+'M'; if(n>=1e3)return(n/1e3).toFixed(1)+'K'; return n.toString(); }\n\nfunction kvRow(key, val) {\n  if (val === undefined || val === null || val === '') return '';\n  if (typeof val === 'object') val = JSON.stringify(val);\n  return `<tr><td>${esc(key)}</td><td>${esc(String(val))}</td></tr>`;\n}\n\nfunction filePills(files, max) {\n  if (!files || !files.length) return '';\n  const shown = files.slice(0, max||10);\n  let h = '<div class=\"file-list\">' + shown.map(f=>`<span class=\"file-pill\">${esc(f)}</span>`).join('');\n  if (files.length > shown.length) h += `<span class=\"file-pill\">+${files.length-shown.length} more</span>`;\n  return h + '</div>';\n}\n\nfunction tokenGrid(tu) {\n  if (!tu) return '';\n  const stats = [\n    [tu.input_tokens, 'Input'],\n    [tu.output_tokens, 'Output'],\n    [tu.api_call_count, 'API Calls'],\n    [tu.cache_read_tokens, 'Cache Read'],\n    [tu.cache_creation_tokens, 'Cache Write'],\n  ];\n  return '<div class=\"token-grid\">' + stats.filter(([v])=>v).map(([v,l])=>`<div class=\"token-stat\"><div class=\"token-stat-value\">${fmtNum(v)}</div><div class=\"token-stat-label\">${l}</div></div>`).join('') + '</div>';\n}\n\nfunction subagentTokens(tu) {\n  if (!tu || !tu.subagent_tokens) return '';\n  const st = tu.subagent_tokens;\n  return `<div class=\"mt-8\"><div class=\"section-title\">Subagent Tokens</div>${tokenGrid(st)}</div>`;\n}\n\nfunction attrBar(a) {\n  if (!a || a.total_committed <= 0) return '';\n  const p = Math.round(a.agent_percentage);\n  return `<div><div class=\"attr-labels\"><span>Agent ${p}% (${a.agent_lines} lines)</span><span>Human ${100-p}% (${a.human_added + a.human_modified} lines)</span></div><div class=\"attr-track\"><div class=\"attr-agent-fill\" style=\"width:${p}%\"></div><div class=\"attr-human-fill\" style=\"width:${100-p}%\"></div></div></div>`;\n}\n\nfunction summaryBox(s) {\n  if (!s) return '';\n  let h = '<div class=\"summary-box\">';\n  if (s.intent) h += `<div class=\"intent\">${esc(s.intent)}</div>`;\n  if (s.outcome) h += `<div class=\"outcome\">${esc(s.outcome)}</div>`;\n  h += '</div>';\n  // Learnings\n  const lrn = s.learnings;\n  if (lrn) {\n    if (lrn.repo && lrn.repo.length) h += `<div class=\"mt-8\"><div class=\"section-title\">Repo Learnings</div>${lrn.repo.map(r=>`<div class=\"learning-item\">${esc(r)}</div>`).join('')}</div>`;\n    if (lrn.code && lrn.code.length) h += `<div class=\"mt-8\"><div class=\"section-title\">Code Learnings</div>${lrn.code.map(c=>`<div class=\"learning-item\"><span class=\"learning-path\">${esc(c.path)}${c.line?':'+c.line:''}</span><div class=\"learning-finding\">${esc(c.finding)}</div></div>`).join('')}</div>`;\n    if (lrn.workflow && lrn.workflow.length) h += `<div class=\"mt-8\"><div class=\"section-title\">Workflow Learnings</div>${lrn.workflow.map(w=>`<div class=\"learning-item\">${esc(w)}</div>`).join('')}</div>`;\n  }\n  if (s.friction && s.friction.length) h += `<div class=\"mt-8\"><div class=\"section-title\">Friction</div>${s.friction.map(f=>`<div class=\"learning-item\">${esc(f)}</div>`).join('')}</div>`;\n  if (s.open_items && s.open_items.length) h += `<div class=\"mt-8\"><div class=\"section-title\">Open Items</div>${s.open_items.map(o=>`<div class=\"learning-item\">${esc(o)}</div>`).join('')}</div>`;\n  return h;\n}\n\nfunction promptAttributions(attrs) {\n  if (!attrs || !attrs.length) return '';\n  let h = '<div class=\"prompt-attr-grid\">';\n  h += '<div class=\"cell cell-header\">#</div><div class=\"cell cell-header\">User +</div><div class=\"cell cell-header\">User -</div><div class=\"cell cell-header\">Agent +</div><div class=\"cell cell-header\">Agent -</div>';\n  attrs.forEach(a => {\n    h += `<div class=\"cell\">${a.checkpoint_number}</div><div class=\"cell\" style=\"color:var(--green)\">${a.user_lines_added}</div><div class=\"cell\" style=\"color:var(--red)\">${a.user_lines_removed}</div><div class=\"cell\" style=\"color:var(--accent)\">${a.agent_lines_added}</div><div class=\"cell\" style=\"color:var(--orange)\">${a.agent_lines_removed}</div>`;\n  });\n  return h + '</div>';\n}\n\n/* Build a full key-value table from any JSON object, showing ALL fields */\nfunction fullKvTable(obj, exclude) {\n  if (!obj) return '';\n  const ex = new Set(exclude || []);\n  let rows = '';\n  for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(obj)) {\n    if (ex.has(k)) continue;\n    if (v === null || v === undefined) continue;\n    if (Array.isArray(v) && v.length === 0) continue;\n    if (typeof v === 'object' && !Array.isArray(v) && Object.keys(v).length === 0) continue;\n\n    let display;\n    if (Array.isArray(v)) {\n      if (v.every(x => typeof x === 'string')) display = v.join(', ');\n      else display = JSON.stringify(v, null, 2);\n    } else if (typeof v === 'object') {\n      display = JSON.stringify(v, null, 2);\n    } else {\n      display = String(v);\n    }\n    rows += `<tr><td>${esc(k)}</td><td>${esc(display)}</td></tr>`;\n  }\n  return rows ? `<table class=\"kv-table\">${rows}</table>` : '';\n}\n\n/* ---- Tabs ---- */\ndocument.querySelector('.tabs').addEventListener('click', e => {\n  const tab = e.target.closest('.tab');\n  if (!tab) return;\n  document.querySelectorAll('.tab').forEach(t => t.classList.remove('active'));\n  document.querySelectorAll('.tab-panel').forEach(p => p.classList.remove('active'));\n  tab.classList.add('active');\n  document.getElementById('panel-' + tab.dataset.tab).classList.add('active');\n  if (tab.dataset.tab === 'shadow' && !shadowLoaded) fetchShadowBranches();\n});\n\n/* ---- Toggle helpers ---- */\nfunction toggle(el) {\n  el.classList.toggle('expanded');\n}\n\n/* ---- Render: Tracked Sessions (raw JSON, all fields) ---- */\nconst sessionExpanded = new Set();\nconst sessionRawMode = new Set();\n\nfunction renderSessions(sessions) {\n  const el = document.getElementById('panel-sessions');\n  document.getElementById('tc-sessions').textContent = sessions.length;\n  if (!sessions.length) { el.innerHTML = '<div class=\"empty-state\"><div class=\"empty-icon\">&#x1f4cb;</div>No tracked sessions</div>'; return; }\n\n  // Sort: active first, then idle, then ended, then by started_at desc\n  const phaseOrder = { active: 0, idle: 1, ended: 2 };\n  sessions.sort((a, b) => {\n    const pa = phaseOrder[(a.phase||'').toLowerCase()] ?? 3;\n    const pb = phaseOrder[(b.phase||'').toLowerCase()] ?? 3;\n    if (pa !== pb) return pa - pb;\n    return new Date(b.started_at||0) - new Date(a.started_at||0);\n  });\n\n  el.innerHTML = sessions.map((s, i) => {\n    const sid = s.session_id || `session-${i}`;\n    const phase = (s.phase || 'unknown').toLowerCase();\n    const expanded = sessionExpanded.has(sid);\n    const rawMode = sessionRawMode.has(sid);\n\n    // Compact row\n    let row = `<div class=\"card-row\" onclick=\"toggleSession('${esc(sid)}')\">\n      <span class=\"badge phase-${esc(phase)}\" style=\"font-size:10px;font-weight:600;text-transform:uppercase\">${esc(s.phase||'?')}</span>\n      <span class=\"text-sm\" style=\"font-weight:500\">${esc(s.agent_type||'Unknown')}</span>\n      <span class=\"text-xs text-dim truncate flex-fill\">${esc(s.first_prompt ? s.first_prompt.substring(0,100) : '')}</span>\n      <span class=\"text-xs text-dim\">steps:${s.checkpoint_count||0}</span>\n      <span class=\"text-xs text-dim\">${relTime(s.started_at)}</span>\n      <span class=\"text-xs mono text-dim\">${esc(sid.substring(0,8))}...</span>\n      <span class=\"chevron\">&#x25B8;</span>\n    </div>`;\n\n    // Detail\n    let detail = '<div class=\"card-detail\">';\n    detail += `<div style=\"display:flex;gap:8px;align-items:center;margin-bottom:12px\">\n      <div class=\"section-title\" style=\"margin:0\">Session State</div>\n      <span class=\"raw-toggle ${rawMode?'active':''}\" onclick=\"event.stopPropagation();toggleSessionRaw('${esc(sid)}')\">RAW JSON</span>\n      <span class=\"text-xs mono text-dim ml-auto\">.git/entire-sessions/${esc(sid)}.json</span>\n    </div>`;\n\n    if (rawMode) {\n      detail += `<div class=\"blob-viewer\"><pre class=\"blob-content\">${esc(JSON.stringify(s, null, 2))}</pre></div>`;\n    } else {\n      // Structured view - show ALL fields\n      const specialKeys = ['token_usage', 'prompt_attributions', 'pending_prompt_attribution', 'files_touched', 'untracked_files_at_start', 'first_prompt'];\n      detail += `<div class=\"detail-section\">${fullKvTable(s, specialKeys)}</div>`;\n\n      if (s.first_prompt) {\n        detail += `<div class=\"detail-section\"><div class=\"section-title\">First Prompt</div><div class=\"blob-viewer\" style=\"max-height:200px\"><pre class=\"blob-content\">${esc(s.first_prompt)}</pre></div></div>`;\n      }\n\n      if (s.token_usage) {\n        detail += `<div class=\"detail-section\"><div class=\"section-title\">Token Usage</div>${tokenGrid(s.token_usage)}${subagentTokens(s.token_usage)}</div>`;\n      }\n\n      if (s.files_touched && s.files_touched.length) {\n        detail += `<div class=\"detail-section\"><div class=\"section-title\">Files Touched (${s.files_touched.length})</div>${filePills(s.files_touched, 30)}</div>`;\n      }\n\n      if (s.untracked_files_at_start && s.untracked_files_at_start.length) {\n        detail += `<div class=\"detail-section\"><div class=\"section-title\">Untracked Files at Start (${s.untracked_files_at_start.length})</div>${filePills(s.untracked_files_at_start, 20)}</div>`;\n      }\n\n      if (s.prompt_attributions && s.prompt_attributions.length) {\n        detail += `<div class=\"detail-section\"><div class=\"section-title\">Prompt Attributions (${s.prompt_attributions.length})</div>${promptAttributions(s.prompt_attributions)}</div>`;\n      }\n\n      if (s.pending_prompt_attribution) {\n        detail += `<div class=\"detail-section\"><div class=\"section-title\">Pending Prompt Attribution</div>${fullKvTable(s.pending_prompt_attribution)}</div>`;\n      }\n    }\n\n    detail += '</div>';\n    return `<div class=\"card${expanded?' expanded':''}\" id=\"sess-${esc(sid)}\">${row}${detail}</div>`;\n  }).join('');\n}\n\nfunction toggleSession(sid) {\n  sessionExpanded.has(sid) ? sessionExpanded.delete(sid) : sessionExpanded.add(sid);\n  renderSessions(lastSessions);\n}\n\nfunction toggleSessionRaw(sid) {\n  sessionRawMode.has(sid) ? sessionRawMode.delete(sid) : sessionRawMode.add(sid);\n  renderSessions(lastSessions);\n}\n\n/* ---- Render: Checkpoints ---- */\nconst cpExpanded = new Set();\nconst cpSessionExpanded = new Set();\nconst cpRawMode = new Set();\nconst cpBlobCache = {};  // key: path -> content\nconst cpBlobActive = {};  // key: cpid+idx -> path\n\nfunction renderCheckpoints(checkpoints) {\n  const el = document.getElementById('panel-checkpoints');\n  document.getElementById('tc-checkpoints').textContent = checkpoints.length;\n  if (!checkpoints.length) { el.innerHTML = '<div class=\"empty-state\"><div class=\"empty-icon\">&#x1f50d;</div>No checkpoints found</div>'; return; }\n\n  el.innerHTML = '<div class=\"timeline\">' + checkpoints.map(cp => {\n    const expanded = cpExpanded.has(cp.checkpoint_id);\n    const sessionCount = (cp.sessions||[]).length;\n\n    let row = `<div class=\"card-row\" onclick=\"toggleCp('${esc(cp.checkpoint_id)}')\">\n      <span class=\"badge badge-accent\" style=\"font-size:12px\">${esc(cp.short_hash)}</span>\n      <span class=\"text-sm truncate flex-fill\" style=\"font-weight:500\">${esc(cp.subject)}</span>\n      <span class=\"badge badge-purple\">${esc(cp.checkpoint_id)}</span>\n      ${sessionCount > 0 ? `<span class=\"badge badge-muted\">${sessionCount} sess</span>` : ''}\n      <span class=\"text-xs text-dim\">${relTime(cp.date)}</span>\n      <span class=\"chevron\">&#x25B8;</span>\n    </div>`;\n\n    let detail = '';\n    if (expanded) {\n      detail = `<div class=\"card-detail\">${renderCpDetail(cp)}</div>`;\n    } else {\n      detail = '<div class=\"card-detail\"></div>';\n    }\n\n    return `<div class=\"card${expanded?' expanded':''}\">${row}${detail}</div>`;\n  }).join('') + '</div>';\n}\n\nfunction toggleCp(cpid) {\n  cpExpanded.has(cpid) ? cpExpanded.delete(cpid) : cpExpanded.add(cpid);\n  renderCheckpoints(lastCheckpoints);\n}\n\nfunction renderCpDetail(cp) {\n  const root = cp.root_metadata;\n  const sessions = cp.sessions || [];\n  const rawMode = cpRawMode.has(cp.checkpoint_id);\n  let h = '';\n\n  h += `<div style=\"display:flex;gap:8px;align-items:center;margin-bottom:12px\">\n    <div class=\"section-title\" style=\"margin:0\">Checkpoint Detail</div>\n    <span class=\"raw-toggle ${rawMode?'active':''}\" onclick=\"event.stopPropagation();toggleCpRaw('${esc(cp.checkpoint_id)}')\">RAW JSON</span>\n  </div>`;\n\n  if (rawMode) {\n    h += `<div class=\"blob-viewer\"><pre class=\"blob-content\">${esc(JSON.stringify({commit:{hash:cp.hash,subject:cp.subject,date:cp.date},root_metadata:root,sessions:sessions.map(s=>s.metadata)}, null, 2))}</pre></div>`;\n    return h;\n  }\n\n  // Commit info\n  h += `<div class=\"detail-section\"><div class=\"section-title\">Commit</div><table class=\"kv-table\">\n    ${kvRow('hash', cp.hash)}${kvRow('subject', cp.subject)}${kvRow('date', cp.date)}${kvRow('checkpoint_id', cp.checkpoint_id)}\n  </table></div>`;\n\n  // Root metadata\n  if (root) {\n    h += `<div class=\"detail-section\"><div class=\"section-title\">Root Metadata <span class=\"text-xs mono text-dim\">${esc(cp.checkpoint_id.substring(0,2))}/${esc(cp.checkpoint_id.substring(2))}/metadata.json</span></div>`;\n    h += fullKvTable(root, ['token_usage', 'files_touched', 'sessions']);\n    if (root.token_usage) h += `<div class=\"mt-8\">${tokenGrid(root.token_usage)}${subagentTokens(root.token_usage)}</div>`;\n    if (root.files_touched && root.files_touched.length) h += `<div class=\"mt-8\">${filePills(root.files_touched, 30)}</div>`;\n    if (root.sessions && root.sessions.length) {\n      h += `<div class=\"mt-8\"><div class=\"section-title\">Session File Paths</div>`;\n      root.sessions.forEach((sp, i) => {\n        h += `<table class=\"kv-table\" style=\"margin-bottom:6px\"><tr><td colspan=\"2\" style=\"color:var(--accent);font-weight:600\">Session ${i}</td></tr>`;\n        for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(sp)) { if (v) h += kvRow(k, v); }\n        h += '</table>';\n      });\n      h += '</div>';\n    }\n    h += '</div>';\n  }\n\n  // Sessions\n  if (sessions.length) {\n    h += `<div class=\"detail-section\"><div class=\"section-title\">Sessions <span class=\"tab-count\">${sessions.length}</span></div>`;\n    sessions.forEach((sess, idx) => {\n      const sessKey = cp.checkpoint_id + '-' + idx;\n      const sessExpanded = cpSessionExpanded.has(sessKey);\n      const meta = sess.metadata || {};\n      const files = sess.files || [];\n\n      h += `<div class=\"sub-session${sessExpanded?' expanded':''}\" id=\"sub-${esc(sessKey)}\">`;\n      h += `<div class=\"sub-session-header\" onclick=\"toggleCpSession('${esc(sessKey)}')\">\n        <span class=\"chevron\">&#x25B8;</span>\n        <span class=\"badge badge-muted\">#${idx}</span>\n        ${meta.agent ? `<span style=\"font-weight:500\">${esc(meta.agent)}</span>` : ''}\n        ${meta.strategy ? `<span class=\"badge badge-muted\">${esc(meta.strategy)}</span>` : ''}\n        ${meta.session_id ? `<span class=\"mono text-dim ml-auto\">${esc(meta.session_id)}</span>` : ''}\n      </div>`;\n\n      if (sessExpanded) {\n        h += '<div class=\"sub-session-detail\">';\n\n        // All metadata fields\n        const metaSpecial = ['token_usage', 'files_touched', 'summary', 'initial_attribution'];\n        h += `<div class=\"detail-section\"><div class=\"section-title\">Metadata <span class=\"text-xs mono text-dim\">${esc(cp.checkpoint_id.substring(0,2))}/${esc(cp.checkpoint_id.substring(2))}/${idx}/metadata.json</span></div>`;\n        h += fullKvTable(meta, metaSpecial);\n        h += '</div>';\n\n        if (meta.token_usage) {\n          h += `<div class=\"detail-section\"><div class=\"section-title\">Token Usage</div>${tokenGrid(meta.token_usage)}${subagentTokens(meta.token_usage)}</div>`;\n        }\n\n        if (meta.initial_attribution) {\n          h += `<div class=\"detail-section\"><div class=\"section-title\">Attribution</div>${attrBar(meta.initial_attribution)}\n            <table class=\"kv-table = true;\n    renderShadowBranches();\n  } catch(e) { console.error(e); }\n}\n\nfunction renderShadowBranches() {\n  const el = document.getElementById('panel-shadow');\n  document.getElementById('tc-shadow').textContent = lastShadowBranches.length;\n  if (!lastShadowBranches.length) { el.innerHTML = '<div class=\"empty-state\"><div class=\"empty-icon\">&#x1f333;</div>No shadow branches</div>'; return; }\n\n  el.innerHTML = lastShadowBranches.map(b => {\n    const expanded = shadowExpanded.has(b.name);\n    let row = `<div class=\"card-row\" onclick=\"toggleShadow('${esc(b.name)}')\">\n      <span class=\"badge badge-accent\" style=\"font-size:11px\">${esc(b.name)}</span>\n      <span class=\"text-xs text-dim\">${esc(b.short_hash)}</span>\n      <span class=\"text-xs text-dim truncate flex-fill\">${esc(b.subject)}</span>\n      <span class=\"text-xs text-dim\">${relTime(b.date)}</span>\n      <span class=\"chevron\">&#x25B8;</span>\n    </div>`;\n\n    let detail = '';\n    if (expanded) {\n      const files = shadowFiles[b.name] || [];\n      const activeBlob = shadowBlobActive[b.name] || b.subject)}</table>`;\n\n      if (files.length) {\n        detail += `<div class=\"mt-12\"><div class=\"section-title\">Files (${files.length})</div><div class=\"file-browser\" style=\"max-height:400px;overflow:auto\">`;\n        // Show metadata files first, then others\n        const metaFiles = files.filter(f => f.includes('.entire/metadata/'));\n        const otherFiles = files.filter(f => !f.includes('.entire/metadata/'));\n        const sorted = [...metaFiles, ...otherFiles];\n        sorted.forEach(f => {\n          const isActive = activeBlob === f;\n          const shortName = f.split('/').pop();\n          const isMeta = f.includes('.entire/metadata/');\n          detail += `<div class=\"file-entry${isActive?' active':''}\" onclick=\"event.stopPropagation();loadShadowBlob('${esc(b.name)}','${esc(f)}')\">${isMeta?'&#x1f4dc;':'&#x1f4c4;'} <span class=\"truncate\">${esc(f)}</span></div>`;\n        });\n        detail += detail += '</div>';\n    }\n\n    return `<div class=\"card${expanded?' expanded':''}\">${row}${detail}</div>`;\n  }).join('');\n}\n\nasync function toggleShadow(name) {\n  if (shadowExpanded.has(name)) { shadowExpanded.delete(name); }\n  else {\n    shadowExpanded.add(name);\n    if (!shadowFiles[name]) {\n      try {\n        const res = await renderShadowBranches();\n}\n\nasync function loadShadowBlob(branch, path) {\n  shadowBlobActive[branch] = path;\n  renderShadowBranches();\n\n  const cacheKey = branch + ':' + path;\n  if (shadowBlobCache[cacheKey] !== undefined) return;\n\n  try {\n    const res = await fetch('/api/shadow-blob?branch=' + encodeURIComponent(branch) + '&path=' + encodeURIComponent(path));\n    if await (async (page) => {
  // Scroll to top first
  await page.evaluate(() => window.scrollTo(0, 0));
  await page.waitForTimeout(200);
  
  // Click the 7-sessions checkpoint
  const rows = page.locator('.timeline .card-row');
  const count = await rows.count();
  for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
    const text = await rows.nth(i).textContent();
    if (text.includes('7 sess')) {
      await rows.nth(i).click();
      break;
    }
  }
  await page.waitForTimeout(1000);
  
  // Now expand session #6 (last one, most likely to have data)
  const subHeaders = page.locator('.sub-session-header');
  const subCount = await subHeaders.count();
  if (subCount > 0) {
    // click last session
    await subHeaders.nth(subCount - 1).click();
    await page.waitForTimeout(500);
  }
  
  // Scroll down
  await page.evaluate(() => {
    const expanded = document.querySelector('.sub-session.expanded');
    if (expanded) expanded.scrollIntoView({ block: 'start' });
  });
  await page.waitForTimeout(500);
})(page);

await (async (page) => {
  // Disable auto-refresh by overriding the interval
  await page.evaluate(() => {
    clearInterval(window._refreshInterval);
    // Store interval ID for later if needed
    window._refreshPaused = true;
  });
  
  // Click "Phase 1" checkpoint (ef27deb) - single session, should have files
  const rows = page.locator('.timeline .card-row');
  const count = await rows.count();
  for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
    const text = await rows.nth(i).textContent();
    if (text.includes('Phase 1')) {
      await rows.nth(i).click();
      break;
    }
  }
  await page.waitForTimeout(800);
  
  // Expand session #0
  const subHeaders = page.locator('.sub-session-header');
  if (await subHeaders.count() > 0) {
    await subHeaders.first().click();
    await page.waitForTimeout(800);
  }
  
  // Scroll to the file browser
  await page.evaluate(() => {
    const fileBrowser = document.querySelector('.file-browser');
    if (fileBrowser) fileBrowser.scrollIntoView({ block: 'center' });
  });
  await page.waitForTimeout(300);
})(page);

```js
await (async (page) => {
  // Stop all intervals
  await page.evaluate(() => {
    const id = setInterval(() => {}, 9999);
    for (let i = 0; i <= id; i++) clearInterval(i);
  });
  // Wait a bit to make sure no re-render happens
  await page.waitForTimeout(500);
  // Click the first checkpoint to expand it
  await page.evaluate(() => {
    const panel = document.getElementById('panel-checkpoints');
    const rows = panel.querySelectorAll('.card-row');
    rows[0].click();
  });
  await page.waitForTimeout(300);
  // Expand the session sub-card
  await page.evaluate(() => {
    const header = document.querySelector('.sub-session-header');
    if (header) header.click();
  });
  await page.waitForTimeout(300);
  // Click prompt.txt file
  await page.evaluate(() => {
    const entries = document.querySelectorAll('.file-entry');
    for (const e of entries) {
      if (e.textContent.includes('prompt.txt')) { e.click(); break; }
    }
  });
  await page.waitForTimeout(500);
  // Scroll to blob viewer
  await page.evaluate(() => {
    const bv = document.querySelector('.blob-viewer');
    if (bv) bv.scrollIntoView({block: 'center'});
  });
  await page.waitForTimeout(300);
  // Take screenshot
  await page.screenshot({path: 'blob-final.png', type: 'png'});
  return 'done';
})(page);

```js
await (async (page) => {
  // Navigate fresh
  await page.goto('http://localhost:8095');
  await page.waitForTimeout(4000); // wait for data load
  
  // Override fetchAll to no-op to stop refresh without clearing intervals
  await page.evaluate(() => { window.fetchAll = () => {}; });
  await page.waitForTimeout(500);
  
  // Switch to checkpoints tab
  await page.evaluate(() => { document.querySelectorAll('.tab')[1].click(); });
  await page.waitForTimeout(200);
  
  // Click first checkpoint
  await page.evaluate(() => {
    const panel = document.getElementById('panel-checkpoints');
    panel.querySelectorAll('.card-row')[0].click();
  });
  await page.waitForTimeout(200);
  
  // Expand session sub-card
  await page.evaluate(() => {
    document.querySelector('.sub-session-header').click();
  });
  await page.waitForTimeout(200);
  
  // Click prompt.txt
  await page.evaluate(() => {
    for (const e of document.querySelectorAll('.file-entry')) {
      if (e.textContent.includes('prompt.txt')) { e.click(); break; }
    }
  });
  await page.waitForTimeout(800);
  
  // Scroll to blob viewer
  await page.evaluate(() => {
    document.querySelector('.blob-viewer').scrollIntoView({block: 'center'});
  });
  await page.waitForTimeout(200);
  
  await page.screenshot({path: 'blob-viewer-final.png', type: 'png'});
  return 'done';
})(page);

    10→// GetWorktreeID returns the internal git worktree identifier for the given path.
    11→// For the main worktree (where .git is a directory), returns empty string.
    12→// For linked worktrees (where .git is a file), extracts the name from
    13→// .git/worktrees/<name>/ path. This name is stable across `git worktree move`.
    14→func GetWorktreeID(worktreePath string) (string, error) {
    15→	gitPath := filepath.Join(worktreePath, ".git")
    16→
    17→	info, err := os.Stat(gitPath)
    18→	if err != nil {
    19→		return "", fmt.Errorf("failed to stat .git: %w", err)
    20→	}
    21→
    22→	// Main worktree has .git as a directory
    23→	if info.IsDir() {
    24→		return "", nil
    25→	}
    26→
    27→	// Linked worktree has .git as a file with content: "gitdir: /path/to/.git/worktrees/<name>"
    28→	content, err := os.ReadFile(gitPath) //nolint:gosec // gitPath is constructed from worktreePath + ".git"
    29→	if err != nil {
    30→		return "", fmt.Errorf("failed to read .git file: %w", err)
    31→	}
    32→
    33→	line := strings.TrimSpace(string(content))
    34→	if !strings.HasPrefix(line, "gitdir: ") {
    35→		return "", fmt.Errorf("invalid .git file format: %s", line)
    36→	}
    37→
    38→	gitdir := strings.TrimPrefix(line, "gitdir: ")
    39→
    40→	// Extract worktree name from path like /repo/.git/worktrees/<name>
    41→	// The path after ".git/worktrees/" is the worktree identifier
    42→	const marker = ".git/worktrees/"
    43→	_, worktreeID, found := strings.Cut(gitdir, marker)
    44→	if !found {
    45→		return "", fmt.Errorf("unexpected gitdir format (no worktrees): %s", gitdir)
    46→	}
    47→	// Remove trailing slashes if any
    48→	worktreeID = strings.TrimSuffix(worktreeID, "/")
    49→
    50→	return worktreeID, nil
    51→}

Matches the CLI's checkpoint.HashWorktreeID().\nfunc worktreeHash() string {\n\t// Determine worktreeID: empty for main worktree, name for linked worktrees.\n\tgitPath := filepath.Join(\".\", \".git\")\n\tinfo, err := os.Stat(gitPath)\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\treturn hashID(\"\")\n\t}\n\tif info.IsDir() {\n\t\t// Main worktree\n\t\treturn hashID(\"\")\n\t}\n\t// Linked worktree: .git file contains \"gitdir: .../.git/worktrees/<name>\"\n\tcontent, err := os.ReadFile(gitPath)\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\treturn hashID(\"\")\n\t}\n\tline := strings.TrimSpace(string(content))\n\tconst marker = \".git/worktrees/\"\n\t_, id, found := strings.Cut(line, marker)\n\tif !found {\n\t\treturn hashID(\"\")\n\t}\n\treturn hashID(strings.TrimSuffix(id, \"/\"))\n}\n\nfunc hashID(id string) string {\n\th := sha256.Sum256([]byte(id))\n\treturn hex.EncodeToString(h[:])[:6]\n}\n\n// --- Cached git common dir ---\n\nvar (\n\tgitCommonDirOnce sync.Once\n\tgitCommonDirVal  string\n)"
}

  await page.evaluate(() => { document.querySelectorAll('.tab')[2].click(); });
  await page.waitForTimeout(300);
  await page.screenshot({path: base + '/06-shadow-branches-tab.png', type: 'png'});
  
  return 'all screenshots taken';
})(page);
```
